Enter your Android platform Key from AMap Open Platform, stored locally on your device. Search and GPS update immediately; restart after changing map tile auth.
How to get and add your own AMap Key

1. Sign in to the AMap Open Platform console (console.amap.com), go to "App Management → My Apps", and click "Create New App".

2. Click "Add Key" next to your app and select "Android Platform" (do NOT select Web or JS API, otherwise native map tiles and POI search will fail authentication).

3. Fill in the two required signing fields:
· PackageName: com.shanghai.memory
· SHA1 Fingerprint: enter the SHA-1 of the signing certificate used by your APK (for self-built debug APKs, run Gradle signingReport in Android Studio or inspect debug.keystore with keytool).

4. Submit, copy the generated 32-character Key, paste it above, and tap Save.

5. Fully close and relaunch the app from system recents so map tiles, GPS, and POI search reload under your own quota. Clear the field and save anytime to revert to the built-in default Key.
